intent: Page navigation with previous, next, page numbers, and ellipsis. Not ButtonGroup. Not Tabs.
doNotUseWhen: a pair of sibling actions — ButtonGroup

page.note: controlled 1-based. Controlled when page is a number.

showPages.note: false shows Previous/Next only (icons-only when showLabels is also false)

showLabels.note: Previous / Next text next to chevrons. Icon-only uses ariaLabel.

showPreviousNext.note: false hides Previous/Next (Simple: page numbers only)

requirements: current page uses kit Button variant=secondary and aria-current=page
ellipsis is a span with Lucide Ellipsis, aria-hidden, not a Button

doNot: do not use ButtonGroup for paging
